name: Hierarchical Multi-scale SR
definition: A hierarchical framework for multi-scale SR chains 2× upscaling networks across levels of an octree data structure. The method iteratively downscales all data to the coarsest uniform grid and then upscales one level at a time, overwriting stale voxels with higher-resolution data at each stage to eliminate seam artifacts.
summary: Hierarchical Multi-scale SR is a deep learning method that iteratively upsamples 3D volumes via octree levels to eliminate seam artifacts, distinguishing itself by leveraging hierarchical spatial decomposition for scale consistency.
